### The Gift of the Spirit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gift-spirit
Passage: Galatians 3:5
Points:
- Trying to earn justification through the Law only brings condemnation, since imperfect obedience leaves sinners under a curse.
- Christ took that divine curse upon Himself at the cross to liberate everyone who trusts in Him.
- Believers receive the Holy Spirit through hearing the gospel with faith, not through legal obedience.
- Reverting to rule-keeping as a ground for standing before God neglects the sufficiency of Christ's sacrifice.
- Good deeds are the fruit of being made righteous in Christ, never the cause of justification.
